text:
sam_support: Customer on trial (acct 9482) reports free-trial balance didn’t change after a successful generation. They received 200 OK from the API and the generated tokens are as expected, but the UI and ledger show old balance. Ticket SUP-4921. Asking for triage + short repro.
mike_billing: Can you paste the customer request headers + x-rd-request-id so we can trace in billing ledger? Also whether this was a streaming or non-streaming request.
sam_support: Streaming. Headers from customer below (redacted):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
Idempotency-Key: client-xyz-2027-05-02
x-rd-request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d
User-Agent: my-app/1.2.3
```
Response from API was 200 and stream closed normally. Customer then did a redirect-based retry (their SDK followed a 302 and retried) — they say retry looked identical.
karen_platform: I'll grep logs for rq_0a1b2c3d and check finalize/finalizer flows. Also check ledger finalize webhook delivery and any missing consume events.
eng_rey: Found the sequence. We received two generate streams with different internal session ids:
```
2027-05-02T13:04:12Z INFO gen start req=rq_0a1b2c3d session=sess-A client-ip=35.201.x.x
2027-05-02T13:04:16Z INFO gen end req=rq_0a1b2c3d session=sess-A tokens=186
2027-05-02T13:04:17Z INFO 302 redirect to /v1/stream (client followed) req=rq_0a1b2c3d session=-- idempotency missing on retry
2027-05-02T13:04:17Z INFO gen start req=rq_0a1b2c3d session=sess-B client-ip=35.201.x.x
2027-05-02T13:04:18Z INFO gen end req=rq_0a1b2c3d session=sess-B tokens=0
```
It looks like the SDK retry after a 302 dropped the Idempotency-Key header, which caused the runtime to start a second session (sess-B). Only sess-A triggered a ledger finalize event; sess-B completed but never emitted a finalize/consume to the billing pipeline (the finalize step is tied to the original session lifecycle). So the ledger never recorded the second completion or deduped it properly — customer balance stayed the same.
sam_support: So root cause is the retry lost the idempotency header => duplicate session without finalize, ledger didn't reconcile. Is that correct? What are mitigation options?
mike_billing: For this customer we should (a) issue a manual provisional credit to match the expected debits while we fix, and (b) create an alert for finalize events not seen within 60s of stream end. Propose credit 500 trial tokens to be safe.
karen_platform: Agreed. Also we should harden server-side to accept idempotency via either Idempotency-Key header OR a fallback composite key (x-client-session-id + client-ip + model + trace-id) for 302-followed retries. I'll open a ticket to change the finalizer to lookup by that composite when header missing.
eng_rey: I'll prototype a short-lived mapping: when a stream starts record (trace-id -> session) for 2 minutes and use it at finalize time to find sessions that lost idempotency. PR and tests planned today. Also adding a unit test that simulates a 302+retry dropping headers.
ops-bot: Created internal incident INC-3472 for "finalize missing after redirect-based retries" and linked SUP-4921.
sam_support: I credited the account 500 trial tokens as a provisional fix and emailed the customer with an explanation + ETA for permanent fix. Marking customer update sent. :thumbsup:
mike_billing: After eng PR merges, ops please run a backfill for affected request-ids between 2027-05-02T12:50 and 2027-05-02T13:20 to reconcile any missing finalize events. Assigning to eng_rey + karen_platform.
eng_rey: Will do a backfill script that matches by client-ip + timestamp window + model. I'll post results here when done.
sam_support: Thanks all — FOLLOWUP: update SDK docs warning about preserving Idempotency-Key across redirects and we should add an FAQ entry. I'll file doc PR after we close INC-3472.
karen_platform: Great. Tentative ETA for fix + backfill: EOD today. Will update when done.
